banner.message: Utsavam Portal launches for every mandal this Ganeshotsav — registrations will open soon.

preRelease.headline: The Portal Arrives Soon
preRelease.subheadline: A refined home for every mandal — donations, digital receipts, and season reporting, reimagined. We're putting the final touches on Utsavam Portal.
preRelease.announcement: Registered mandals will be notified the moment the portal goes live. No action needed on your part.

postRelease.headline: Utsavam Portal is Live!
postRelease.subheadline: Every donation, every receipt, every season — all in one place. Step inside and set up your mandal.
postRelease.announcement: Welcome to the full Utsavam experience.

features.title: Instant Digital Receipts

features.title: Trusted Collector Access

features.title: Real-Time Collection Reports

features.title: Your Mandal's Identity
